newsitem.title: INDIA: Adidas announces goods launch in India.
newsitem.headline: Adidas announces goods launch in India.

text.p: Adidas India Trading Private Ltd, a joint venture of Germany's Adidas AG, said on Friday it would launch its range of sports shoes, apparel and accessories this month in India.

The products will be available in selected stores in the main metropolitan cities of Delhi, Bombay, Calcutta and Madras in the next two weeks, and in all other cities with a population of more than one million by next June, Adidas officials said.

The sports shoes to be launched in phases will eventually include 35 models. In apparel and accessories, 100 out of an intended 150 articles are being introduced in the first phase of the launch, Adidas said in a statement.

Christoph Holland, managing diector of Adidas India Private Ltd, a wholly-owned Adidas subsidiary, told a news conference that Adidas expected five million customers in the medium term in major Indian cities.

"The current market size is frankly not exciting," said G. Kannan, sales and marketing manager of Adidas India Trading. He added that Adidas would promote sporting events to increase the size of the sports shoe market.

The apparel range will be entirely sourced from India's Magnum International Trading Co, Adidas officials said. Magnum holds 20 percent and Adidas India 80 percent in Adidas India Trading Private Ltd.
Adidas officials said most components for Adidas' shoes in India will be imported. Eventually, Adidas expects to increase the Indian content in the shoes, Holland said.
